title: Payesh telemetry event v1 (row 80) — opt-in, no PII
description: One error/telemetry event. CLOSED field allowlist: additionalProperties is false and no field can hold a name, national id, phone, e-mail, user/student id or free text. The same allowlist is enforced by client/telemetry.js (drops anything else) and by payesh_direct.telemetry_ingest (refuses the batch). tests/telemetry-80.js keeps the three in sync and turns red when a PII-like field is added.

code.description: machine error code (payesh_core error codes / DirectError.code), never a message

where.description: screen or component id, e.g. sync.push

x-pii-guard: no string value may contain 7+ consecutive digits, '@' or whitespace
x-transport: direct path only (row 110): rpc telemetry_ingest(p_events jsonb, p_consent boolean); never through the Gateway
